versions.changelog:
Initial release of hash-generate skill.

- Compute hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, CRC32)
- Generate HMACs and encode/decode (base64, hex, URL); generate UUIDs
- Identify unknown hash algorithms
- Usage limits: 10 free queries/day, no authentication required
- Sends input to external API; no storage or logging of data beyond the immediate response
